mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) above 4.5% over two consecutive months signals a tightening cycle that raises discount rates and reduces present value of future corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.10) during periods when FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5% for two months.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year decline in real personal consumption expenditures (proxied by GDPC1) of more than 2% coincident with a drop in housing starts (HOUST) below 500k units for three consecutive months signals weakening consumer demand, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 YoY < -2% AND HOUST < 500k for three months
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) during periods meeting the trigger.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 8% for two consecutive months, combined with a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 97 for three months, indicates a deepening labor market contraction and economic slack, which typically precedes negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE > 8% for two months AND INDPRO < 97 for three months
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.10) during periods meeting the trigger.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in industrial production (INDPRO) above 0.5% for four consecutive months signals a manufacturing expansion, which historically correlates with positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days due to improved corporate earnings expectations.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) during periods of four consecutive months of INDPRO > 0.5% growth.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp monthly increase in payroll employment (PAYEMS) of more than 100,000 jobs for three consecutive months, in the absence of a corresponding rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE), signals a tight labor market that boosts wage growth and consumer spending, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS > 100000 for three months AND UNRATE flat or falling
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) during periods meeting the trigger in a late-cycle expansion.

mechanism_narrative: A rapid decline in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) below 2% for two consecutive months, accompanied by a federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 1%, signals a risk of deflationary pressure, which historically precedes negative risk sentiment and lower equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL < 2% for two months AND FEDFUNDS < 1%
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.10) during periods meeting the trigger.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in real personal savings (RSAFS) above the prior year's level by more than 5% for two consecutive months, while consumer spending (GDPC1) is flat, indicates a buildup of precautionary savings that typically precedes a pullback in consumption and earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS > prior year +5% for two months AND GDPC1 flat
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) during periods meeting the trigger.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly surge in industrial production (INDPRO) above 1.0% for two consecutive months, with a simultaneous rise in the housing starts index (HOUST) above 550k units, signals a coordinated expansion in manufacturing and construction, which typically boosts corporate earnings and equity valuations, resulting in positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO > 1.0% AND HOUST > 550k for two months
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.10) during periods meeting the trigger in an early-cycle recovery.
